findings.explanation: s34 states the verdict note condition exactly (the federal tax rulings do not test state jurisdiction). For the editor: the package also holds State v. Smith (Ohio App. 2024, L228-L265, cited here for the uniformly-reject claim), a state appeals court calling status arguments such as sovereign or Moorish citizenship "wholly invalid". It is not a declared state-citizenship ruling, so the sentence stays true, but a reader may infer state courts have never addressed declared status.
findings.suggestion: Optional: a later revision could note that a state appeals court rejected related status arguments, citing State v. Smith under the declaring claim only if a verdict links it (record-sources, a person).
